worked_solution:
Evaluating the function at $t=\frac{\pi }{3},$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r(\frac{\pi }{3}) & =⟨\operatorname{sin}⁡(4\cdot \frac{\pi }{3}),\,\operatorname{cos}⁡(4\cdot \frac{\pi }{3})⟩ \\  & =⟨-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2},\,-\frac{1}{2}⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the magnitude of this vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|r(\frac{\pi }{3})| & =\sqrt{{(-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})}^{2}+{(-\frac{1}{2})}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{3}{4}+\frac{1}{4}} \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
